=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/build_state_snapshot.py:147 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_placeholder_tracking_summary` hardcodes `"status": "in-progress"` for placeholder tracking summaries.
  WHY: Empty/no-work tick snapshots can report stale terminal states as in-progress until a later non-empty tick updates the tracker export.
- scripts/build_state_snapshot.py:310-323 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_placeholder_tracking_summary` hardcodes `"status": "in-progress"` for placeholder tracking summaries used when a tracking issue is present in `tracking_issues.json` but missing from tracker exports.
  WHY: Empty-tick snapshots can report incorrect terminal states instead of the source issue’s actual status; one reviewer rated this medium and the other did not state severity.
- scripts/build_state_snapshot.py:198-220 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `_latest_ledger_enrichment()` caches `(None, None)` on corrupted or invalid ledger data, turning validation errors into silence.
  WHY: Silent enrichment failures reduce observability for run-ledger data issues and make token/substate collection problems harder to debug.
- scripts/build_state_snapshot.py:468 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The `main()` cleanup path does not remove the temporary schema-only tree created in the `--memory-root-dir` path.
  WHY: Leftover temporary directories can accumulate on runners and eventually cause disk or inode pressure.
- scripts/build_state_snapshot.py:560-565 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `main()` leaves the temporary schema copy tree uncollected in the `--memory-root-dir` workflow path.
  WHY: Temporary directories can accumulate across poll ticks and eventually cause resource pressure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14147-14150 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `write_state_snapshot_tracker_export "${TRACKING_NUM}" "${TRACKING_TITLE}" || true` runs for every tracking issue on every poll tick, rewriting identical tracker JSON and swallowing real write failures.
  WHY: The repeated writes add unnecessary I/O and workflow duration, and the `|| true` masks serialization or filesystem errors; severity differs across reviewers (low/medium/unspecified), so the higher medium applies.
